barbarian_helmet.name: Barbarian Helmet
barbarian_helmet.description: A rugged iron helmet, scarred from countless battles. It offers solid protection while marking its wearer as a fearless warrior of the wild lands.

barbarian_chestplate.name: Barbarian Chestplate
barbarian_chestplate.description: A heavy chestplate forged from crude iron and reinforced with thick leather straps. Built to absorb brutal blows, it favors raw durability over refined craftsmanship.

barbarian_pants.name: Barbarian Pants
barbarian_pants.description: Rough, battle-worn trousers made from thick leather and fur. They provide solid protection while allowing the freedom needed for relentless combat.

barbarian_boots.name: Barbarian Boots
barbarian_boots.description: Heavy boots reinforced with iron and stitched hide. Designed to endure harsh terrain, they grant stability and resilience in the heat of battle.

barbarian_sword.name: Barbarian Sword
barbarian_sword.description: A massive, brutally forged blade that favors strength over finesse. Each swing delivers devastating force, capable of cleaving through armor and bone alike.

barbarian_amulet.name: Barbarian Amulet
barbarian_amulet.description: A primitive talisman imbued with the spirit of ancient warriors. It bolsters vitality and awakens a savage battle instinct within its wearer.

sunken_treasure_ring.name: Sunken Treasure Ring
sunken_treasure_ring.description: A forgotten ring recovered from the ocean depths, still gleaming with the promise of lost riches and ancient secrets.

barbarian_ring.name: Barbarian Ring
barbarian_ring.description: A rugged ring forged by fierce warriors, granting its wearer enhanced strength and an unyielding battle spirit.

paladin_helmet.name: Paladin Helmet
paladin_helmet.description: A sacred helmet blessed by divine power, offering steadfast protection and inspiring courage in the face of darkness.

paladin_chestplate.name: Paladin Chestplate
paladin_chestplate.description: A blessed chestplate that shields its wearer with divine protection and unwavering resolve.

paladin_pants.name: Paladin Pants
paladin_pants.description: Holy leg armor crafted to provide resilience and freedom of movement in battle.

paladin_boots.name: Paladin Boots
paladin_boots.description: Sanctified boots that carry their wearer swiftly and confidently across any battlefield.

paladin_sword.name: Paladin Sword
paladin_sword.description: A righteous blade forged to smite darkness and uphold the light of justice.

paladin_amulet.name: Paladin Amulet
paladin_amulet.description: A sacred amulet imbued with divine energy, strengthening faith and protecting against evil.

paladin_ring.name: Paladin Ring
paladin_ring.description: A holy ring that enhances its wearer's devotion, courage, and divine power.

ranger_helmet.name: Ranger Helmet
ranger_helmet.description: A finely crafted hooded helm that sharpens the wearer's senses and awareness in the wild.

ranger_chestplate.name: Ranger Chestplate
ranger_chestplate.description: Lightweight armor designed for agility, providing protection without hindering movement.

ranger_pants.name: Ranger Pants
ranger_pants.description: Durable trousers made for long journeys, offering comfort and flexibility across rugged terrain.

ranger_boots.name: Ranger Boots
ranger_boots.description: Silent boots that allow their wearer to move swiftly and unseen through forests and wilderness.

ranger_sword.name: Ranger Sword
ranger_sword.description: A balanced blade favored by skilled hunters, combining speed, precision, and reliability.

ranger_amulet.name: Ranger Amulet
ranger_amulet.description: A nature-blessed amulet that enhances focus, precision, and connection to the wild.

ranger_ring.name: Ranger Ring
ranger_ring.description: An enchanted ring that improves agility, sharpens instincts, and guides its wearer through danger.

robo_helmet.name: Robo Helmet
robo_helmet.description: An advanced combat helmet equipped with enhanced sensors, providing superior awareness and tactical precision.

robo_chestplate.name: Robo Chestplate
robo_chestplate.description: A reinforced alloy chestplate engineered to withstand heavy impacts and extreme conditions.

robo_pants.name: Robo Pants
robo_pants.description: High-tech leg armor designed for durability, flexibility, and efficient power distribution.

robo_boots.name: Robo Boots
robo_boots.description: Mechanized boots that enhance mobility, stability, and movement speed across any terrain.

robo_sword.name: Robo Sword
robo_sword.description: A cutting-edge energy blade capable of delivering precise and devastating strikes.

robo_amulet.name: Robo Amulet
robo_amulet.description: A futuristic energy core that boosts system performance and strengthens defensive protocols.

robo_ring.name: Robo Ring
robo_ring.description: A cybernetic ring that improves processing efficiency, combat accuracy, and overall performance.
